main_body: Round tabletop (a large orange wooden disc with a plate and a small square box on it) on a single dark pedestal stem and base
top_band: Light orange to tan ellipse, rows ~2-10, with a darker brown rim at the front edge around rows 10-11
evidence: A single column through the middle shows a wide foreshortened ellipse top (about 8 rows) with a darker front rim, then the narrow dark pedestal stem set back under the top (rows ~11-14) and a base at the bottom. This is a horizontal surface seen from above plus supports below, like the guide's seat with legs. The top is large and close to a plan view, but it is an ellipse with a visible rim and a stem below, so it is not a flat slab or a front elevation.

style.evidence: The tabletop has a highlight, a light tone, a mid tone and a dark brown rim, and the outline leans brown beside the wood, which is good. The pedestal is a flat near-black shape with almost no shading. Texture is limited to the plate and box details, and the large tabletop areas are fairly smooth with no grain. It is cleanly drawn but has fewer steps and less per-tile information than the stall and well references, so it looks thinner next to them.
